title: Advertisement: Pet grooming salon opening
passage:
Pawsitive Grooming Opens on Birch Road!

Is your dog overdue for a bath? Our experienced groomers treat every animal with patience and care. Each member of our team has completed a certified grooming course and has at least three years of hands-on experience. We welcome all breeds, from tiny terriers to large retrievers. Many customers tell us that their dogs are calmer after their first visit. Our salon is located in the former post office building on Birch Road, and its quiet grooming rooms are separated from the reception area, so nervous pets can relax away from the noise of the street.

Services
• Bath and blow-dry: $35 for small dogs, $50 for large dogs
• Full haircut: $60 and up, depending on coat type
• Nail trimming and ear cleaning: $15, available with any service

All tools are sterilized after every appointment, and the bathing area is cleaned with pet-safe products. Payment can be made by cash, credit card, or mobile payment.

Opening special: Book any service during our first two weeks and receive a free brushing session for your pet. Appointments are recommended, and we suggest booking at least three days in advance. Our staff will also explain how to keep your pet's coat healthy between visits, and this advice is included with every service. Puppies are welcome to visit the salon with their owners to get used to the dryers and clippers before their first full appointment. We also welcome walk-in customers on Saturdays, but only for nail trimming.

Call 555-0139 or visit our website to make a reservation. Free parking is available behind the building, and the salon is a five-minute walk from the Birch Road bus stop. If you need to cancel, please call us at least 24 hours before your appointment. We are open Tuesday through Saturday, 9:00 A.M. to 6:00 P.M. We look forward to meeting you and your furry friends, and we hope to become your neighborhood's favorite grooming salon.

title: Article: Hometown newspaper drops its print edition
passage:
Harbor Ledger to Go Digital-Only

Harbor City residents who read the local paper over breakfast will soon need to change their habits. Many longtime readers have written to the newsroom to say how much they will miss the printed edition. After 112 years of daily printing, the Harbor Ledger will publish its last paper edition on December 31. — [1] — The newspaper's publisher, Greg Halloway, said the decision was difficult but necessary, because printing costs have risen sharply and advertising revenue has continued to fall. Paper and ink prices have roughly doubled since 2020, and delivery trucks now cost far more to run on the longer routes that serve the outlying towns. Several large local retailers have also moved their advertising to social media, which has made it harder for the paper to cover its costs. — [2] — Subscribers will receive a full digital edition, which will be updated throughout the day rather than once each morning. The digital edition will include the same photographs, obituaries, and local event listings that readers see in print today. — [3] — Readers without internet access can still read a printed copy of the paper at the public library. — [4] —

Mr. Halloway added that the newsroom will not shrink. In fact, the paper plans to hire two more reporters to cover the city council and local schools. Both positions are expected to be filled by the end of January, and the new reporters will be based in the paper's downtown office. Print subscribers will receive a 40 percent discount on their first year of digital access, and anyone who wishes to cancel may do so before the end of the year without penalty. Mr. Halloway said the staff would welcome feedback from readers during the transition. He also invited residents to visit the newsroom on the last Saturday of December to see the final printing presses before they are removed. The paper's archive, which dates back more than a century, will remain available to subscribers online.
translation:
ハーバー・レジャー紙、デジタル版のみに

ハーバー市で朝食の時間に地元紙を読んでいる人たちは、まもなく習慣を変える必要がありそうです。長年の読者の多くが、紙面版がなくなることを惜しむ手紙を編集局に寄せています。112年間、毎日紙で発行してきたハーバー・レジャー紙は、12月31日に最後の紙面版を発行する。発行人のグレッグ・ハロウェイは、印刷費が大幅に上がり、広告収入も減り続けているため、難しいが必要な決断だったと述べた。2020年以降、紙とインクの価格はおよそ2倍になり、郊外の町へ届ける配送トラックも、遠回りになったため運行費が大きく増えている。地元の大手小売店も広告をソーシャルメディアへ移しており、紙面の経費をまかなうことがさらに難しくなっている。購読者には完全なデジタル版が届き、朝の1回ではなく一日を通して更新される。デジタル版には、現在紙面で読まれている写真、訃報、地域の催し物情報と同じものが掲載される。インターネットを使えない読者は、公立図書館で紙面を読むことができる。

ハロウェイ氏は、編集局は縮小しないと付け加えた。実際、市議会と地元の学校を取材するため、記者を2人増員する計画だ。両方のポストは1月末までに埋まる見込みで、新しい記者は市の中心部にある紙の本社オフィスに所属する。紙の購読者は、デジタル版を利用する最初の1年間が40%引きになる。年末までに解約を希望する人は、違約金なしで解約できる。ハロウェイ氏は、移行期間中は読者からの意見を歓迎すると述べた。また、12月の最後の土曜日に編集局を一般公開し、撤去される前の最後の印刷機を見学できるようにするとも呼びかけた。100年以上のバックナンバーは、引き続き購読者がオンラインで閲覧できる。

title: Email: Mentorship program for new hires
passage:
From: Lydia Cho, Human Resources
To: Ben Tanaka
Date: September 14
Subject: Welcome to the mentorship program

Dear Ben,

Welcome to Cedar Point Logistics! We are pleased to tell you that you have been matched with a mentor for your first six months. Your mentor is Sofia Alvarez, who has worked in our customer accounts department for nine years. Ms. Alvarez is known for her clear feedback and her patience with new staff. We hope this program will help you settle into your role quickly and build relationships across departments. You will meet with her once every two weeks, either in person or by video call. Ms. Alvarez has also agreed to introduce you to colleagues in the sales and shipping teams, so that you will know who to contact for questions about company procedures.

Each session lasts 45 minutes. Ms. Alvarez has asked you to bring a list of questions or current projects to each meeting so that the time can be used well. Sessions are informal, so there is no need to prepare a formal presentation. Many new employees find that regular conversations with a mentor help them understand how the company's departments work together, so we encourage you to be open about your goals. Mentors and mentees are also encouraged to set one goal for the first three months. The first meeting is scheduled for Thursday, September 19, at 2:00 P.M. in Conference Room C, which is on the third floor next to the elevators. Please arrive on time, since the room is booked for the rest of that week.

If you cannot attend a session, please inform Ms. Alvarez at least one day in advance, and also let Human Resources know so that the schedule can be updated. Participants who complete the program will receive a certificate and a $200 allowance for professional development courses. The certificate will be issued by Human Resources at the end of the program, and the allowance can be used for courses approved by your manager.

If you have any questions before your first meeting, please contact me at extension 417.

Best regards,
Lydia Cho
translation:
送信者:人事部のリディア・チョ
宛先:ベン・タナカ
日付:9月14日
件名:メンター制度へようこそ

ベンさま

シーダー・ポイント物流へようこそ!あなたの最初の6か月のメンターが決まりましたので、お知らせします。メンターはソフィア・アルバレスさんで、当社の顧客口座部門で9年間働いています。アルバレスさんは、的確なフィードバックと新入社員への根気強い指導で知られています。このプログラムが、あなたが早く業務に慣れ、部署をまたいで人間関係を築く助けになることを願っています。2週間に1回、対面かビデオ通話でお会いいただきます。アルバレスさんは、営業部と出荷部の同僚も紹介してくださることになりました。社内の手続きについて質問があるときに、誰に聞けばよいかが分かるようにするためです。

1回の面談は45分です。限られた時間を有効に使えるよう、アルバレスさんからは毎回、質問リストか進行中の仕事を持参するよう依頼がありました。面談は堅苦しいものではないので、正式な発表資料を準備する必要はありません。メンターと定期的に話すことで、会社の各部署がどう連携しているかを理解しやすくなる新入社員は多くいます。そのため、目標についても率直に話してください。また、メンターと一緒に最初の3か月の目標を一つ決めることをおすすめします。初回は9月19日(木)午後2時、会議室Cで予定しています。会議室Cは3階のエレベーターの隣にあります。その週は会議室が予約済みなので、時間どおりにお越しください。

出席できない場合は、少なくとも1日前にアルバレスさんへご連絡ください。あわせて人事部にも知らせて、予定を更新できるようにしてください。プログラムを修了した方には、修了証と専門能力開発講座のための200ドルの手当が支給されます。修了証はプログラム終了時に人事部から発行され、手当は上司が承認した講座に使えます。

初回の面談の前に質問があれば、内線417の私までご連絡ください。

よろしくお願いいたします。
リディア・チョ

title: Triple passage: Mobile phone plans, e-mail, and customer reply
passage:
【Document 1: Plan chart】
Fernway Mobile: Monthly Plans (tax not included)
Basic 5GB: $25 per month, unlimited calls within the country
Plus 20GB: $40 per month, includes 500 minutes of international calls
Max 60GB: $58 per month, includes high-definition streaming
Overage charge: Data used beyond your plan's limit is billed at $5 per additional gigabyte, up to a maximum of $20 per month.
Roaming: Data used abroad is charged at $10 per gigabyte, regardless of plan. A Travel Pass costs $15 per week and includes up to 10 gigabytes abroad at no additional charge.
Plan changes: You may change your plan at any time through the app, and the new plan takes effect at the start of your next billing cycle.
Usage alerts: We send a text message when you have used 80 percent of your data allowance.
Travel Pass: Passes can be purchased through the app or at any store, and they start on the day of purchase.
Network coverage: Our network covers more than 95 percent of the population, including most rural areas.
Customer support: Our support team is available by phone and e-mail from 8:00 A.M. to 10:00 P.M. every day.

【Document 2: E-mail】
From: Hana Okada
To: support@fernwaymobile.com
Date: April 9
Subject: Unexpected charge

Hello,
I have been a customer for six years and usually check my bill carefully, so this charge surprised me. I am on the Plus 20GB plan. Last month I used about 23 gigabytes at home, so I expected an overage charge of about $15. However, my bill came to $35 in total. I also spent six days in Canada on a business trip, where I used about two gigabytes. I did not buy a Travel Pass because I assumed my plan would cover data abroad. My trip was for a client meeting, and my company does not reimburse unexpected phone charges, so I need this resolved quickly. I would like to know why the extra $20 was charged. My account number is listed on my last bill, and I can send a copy if needed.

Thank you,
Hana Okada

【Document 3: Reply】
From: Fernway Customer Support
To: Hana Okada
Date: April 11
Subject: RE: Unexpected charge

Dear Ms. Okada,
Thank you for contacting us. We understand that unexpected charges can be frustrating, and we appreciate your patience. We have reviewed your account. Your overage charge of $15 is correct, since you exceeded your plan's 20-gigabyte limit by three gigabytes. Your data use in Canada, however, was billed at the roaming rate of $10 per gigabyte, which is why the second charge is $20. Because this was your first trip abroad with us, we will refund half of the roaming charge. The refund will appear on your next statement. Your Plus 20GB plan itself remains the same. In the future, you may wish to buy a Travel Pass before you travel. It would have cost you $15 and covered the data you used. We have also updated our roaming information page so that customers can check current rates before they travel. We appreciate your loyalty and look forward to serving you for many years to come.

Sincerely,
Fernway Customer Support

title: Triple passage: Visitor policy notice, family e-mail, and nurse's reply
passage:
【Document 1: Notice】
Lakeview Memorial Hospital: Visitor Policy Update
Effective October 1
The new rules were developed by the hospital's infection control team to protect patients who are recovering from surgery.
• Surgical ward: Patients may receive up to two visitors at a time, between 10:00 A.M. and 8:00 P.M. Visitors must be at least 12 years old and must wear a visitor badge at all times. Badges are available at the front desk on the ground floor. Staff may ask visitors to step out of the room during medical procedures or when a patient needs to rest.
• Intensive care unit: Visits are limited to 15 minutes per hour, and only immediate family members are permitted. Children under 12 may not visit. Visitors must wash their hands before entering and after leaving the unit.
• Visitors with a cold, fever, or cough should postpone their visit. Visitors who are unsure whether they are well enough to visit should call the ward before coming. Hand sanitizer is available at every entrance.
• Parking: The main parking garage is open 24 hours a day, and visitors may park there for up to four hours.
• Visitor lounge: A quiet lounge is available on the second floor for families who need a short break.

【Document 2: E-mail】
From: Marisol Reyes
To: Patient Services
Date: October 4
Subject: Visiting my father

Hello,
My father is recovering in the surgical ward after his knee operation. The surgery went well, and the doctors expect him to go home within two weeks, but he still gets tired easily. I would like to visit him with my two children, who are nine and eleven years old. They have been asking to see their grandfather every day since his operation. Would they be allowed to come up to the ward? My brother also plans to join me. He lives two hours away and is taking the day off work to come with us. Because my shift ends at 7:30 P.M., I can only arrive around 7:45, so I hope the staff can let us stay a little longer than 8:00 P.M. We understand if this is not possible, and we will follow whatever the ward decides.

I appreciate your help with this.

Thank you,
Marisol Reyes

【Document 3: Reply】
From: Helen Ward, Nurse Manager, Surgical Ward
To: Marisol Reyes
Date: October 5
Subject: RE: Visiting my father

Dear Ms. Reyes,
Thank you for your message. We are glad to hear that your father is making good progress after his operation. Unfortunately, children under 12 are not permitted in the surgical ward, so your children will need to wait until your father is discharged. In the meantime, you are welcome to send them a drawing or a card through the front desk, and the nurses will pass it on to him. You and your brother are welcome to visit together, since two visitors are allowed at one time. Please remember that both of you must wear badges and sign in at the front desk before going up. We are unable to extend visiting hours past 8:00 P.M., but please arrive by 7:45 P.M. so that you have time to collect your visitor badges at the front desk. If the front desk is busy when you arrive, our staff will help you as quickly as possible. Please call the ward directly if your plans change, and we will do our best to help.

Best regards,
Helen Ward

【文書1:お知らせ】レイクビュー記念病院:面会規則の変更(10月1日から)/新しい規則は、手術後の回復中の患者を守るため、病院の感染管理チームが作成しました。/外科病棟:患者1人につき、午前10時から午後8時まで、同時に2人まで面会可。面会者は12歳以上で、常に面会バッジを着用すること。バッジは1階の受付で受け取れる。スタッフは、処置中や患者が休息を必要とするときに、面会者に部屋の外へ出てもらうことがある。/集中治療室:面会は1時間に15分まで、直系の家族のみ。12歳未満の子どもは面会不可。面会者は、病棟に入る前と出た後に手を洗うこと。/風邪・発熱・せきのある人は面会を延期すること。面会できる体調か迷う人は、来院前に病棟へ電話すること。消毒液は各入口に置いてある。/駐車:院内の主要な駐車場は終日利用でき、面会者は最長4時間まで駐車できる。/面会者ラウンジ:2階に静かなラウンジがあり、疲れた家族が少し休憩できる。

【文書2:メール】送信者:マリソル・レイエス/宛先:患者サービス窓口/10月4日/件名:父の面会について/父は膝の手術後、外科病棟で回復中です。手術は順調で、医師からは2週間以内の退院が見込まれると言われましたが、まだすぐに疲れてしまいます。9歳と11歳の子ども2人を連れて面会したいのですが、病棟に上がれますか。子どもたちは、手術後ずっと毎日、祖父に会いたいと言っています。兄も一緒に来る予定です。兄は2時間離れた所に住んでおり、仕事を休んで同行してくれます。仕事は午後7時30分に終わるので、到着は7時45分ごろになります。午後8時を過ぎても少し滞在させてもらえないか、ご相談させてください。難しい場合は、病棟の判断に従います。ご対応いただき感謝しております。よろしくお願いいたします。マリソル・レイエス

【文書3:返信】送信者:ヘレン・ウォード(外科病棟看護師長)/宛先:マリソル・レイエス/10月5日/件名:RE:父の面会について/レイエス様/ご連絡ありがとうございます。お父さまが手術後順調に回復されていると伺い、安心いたしました。あいにく12歳未満の子どもは外科病棟に入れないため、お子さんは、お父さまが退院されるまでお待ちください。その間、受付を通じてお子さんが描いた絵やカードをお送りいただければ、看護師が父上にお渡しします。同時に2人まで面会できるため、あなたとお兄様は一緒に面会いただけます。ただし、二人とも面会バッジを着用し、上がる前に受付で記帳していただく必要があります。面会時間の午後8時以降の延長はできません。ただし、受付でバッジを受け取る時間を考えて、午後7時45分までにはお越しください。到着時に受付が混み合っている場合は、スタッフができるだけ早く対応します。ご予定が変わる場合は病棟へ直接お電話ください。できる限りお手伝いいたします。

title: Triple passage: Wedding package list, client e-mail, and reply
passage:
【Document 1: Package list】
Clearwater Photography: Wedding Packages
Essential: 4 hours of coverage, 200 edited photos — $1,400
Premier: 6 hours of coverage, 400 edited photos, and one album — $2,000
Signature: Coverage of up to 10 hours, 600 edited photos, two albums, and a drone shot — $2,900
Additional hour of coverage: $180 (Essential and Premier packages only)
A 30 percent deposit is required to hold a date and is non-refundable. The remaining balance is due 30 days before the event. All packages include a private online gallery where couples can view and download their photos for one year. Our photographers arrive at least 30 minutes before the ceremony to set up equipment and check the lighting. Engagement sessions are not included in any package but can be booked separately. Travel within 50 miles of our studio is included; beyond that, mileage charges apply. Once a booking is confirmed, the wedding date cannot be changed without the approval of the studio manager.

【Document 2: E-mail】
From: Felicia Grant
To: bookings@clearwaterphoto.com
Date: March 2
Subject: Our wedding on September 13

Hello,
We are so excited about our wedding and have been planning it for over a year. We booked the Premier package last June and paid the deposit at that time. Our ceremony now begins at 11:00 A.M., and the reception ends at 7:00 P.M., so the day will last about eight hours instead of six. The extra time is needed for the family photos and the first dance, which we would like to capture properly. We would like to add two hours of coverage to our package. Our guests have traveled from several countries, so we want every moment of the day to be recorded. Our families are very involved in the planning, and everyone is looking forward to the day. We are also thinking about a drone shot, which our friends have recommended. Would it be possible to switch to the Signature package instead? My mother has offered to help us plan the timeline for the photos. Please let us know the total cost so that we can plan our budget.

Thank you,
Felicia Grant

【Document 3: Reply】
From: Clearwater Bookings
To: Felicia Grant
Date: March 4
Subject: RE: Our wedding on September 13

Dear Ms. Grant,
Thank you for your message. We are delighted to hear about your wedding and are happy to help make the day special. We are holding September 13 for you, and your deposit is on record. Two additional hours can be added to the Premier package at the standard hourly rate. Please note that the extra hours will be billed at the same rate for both the ceremony and the reception. Switching to the Signature package is also possible, and it includes the drone shot. Our drone pilot is licensed and will need to confirm the weather on the wedding day. Please let us know your decision by the end of this month so that we can update your contract. Once we receive your decision, we will send you a revised summary of the package and the payment schedule. If you would like to review the timeline together, our planning team is available for a short call next week. Thank you for choosing Clearwater.

Sincerely,
Clearwater Bookings

【文書2:メール】送信者:フェリシア・グラント/宛先:予約窓口/3月2日/件名:9月13日の結婚式について/結婚式を楽しみにしており、1年以上前から準備を進めています。プレミアを昨年6月に予約し、そのときにデポジットを支払いました。挙式は午前11時に始まり、披露宴は午後7時に終わるため、一日は6時間ではなく約8時間になります。その追加の時間は、家族写真やファーストダンスをきちんと残すために必要です。撮影を2時間追加したいと考えています。ゲストは複数の国から来るため、一日の一瞬一瞬を記録してほしいと思っています。家族も準備に深く関わっており、全員がその日を楽しみにしています。ドローン撮影も検討しており、友人からも勧められました。シグネチャーに変更することは可能でしょうか。母が写真の時間配分を一緒に考えてくれると申し出てくれています。予算を立てられるよう、総額を教えてください。よろしくお願いいたします。フェリシア・グラント
